source.author: stat
source.text: dum fata dabant tibi, nate, potentem Lemnon et externis etiam servare timendam gentibus, haud umquam iusto mea cura labori destitit: absciderunt tristes crudelia Parcae stamina, nec dictis, supplex quae plurima fudi ante Iovem frustra, lacrimisque avertere luctus contigit; infandum natae concessit honorem, accelerate fugam, tuque, o mea digna propago, hac rege, virgo, patrem, gemini qua bracchia muri litus eunt: illa, qua rere silentia, porta stat funesta Venus ferroque accincta furentes adiuvat unde manus, unde haec Mavortia divae pectora? : tu lato patrem committe profundo, succedam curis.
source.text_original: 'dum fata dabant tibi, nate, potentem / Lemnon et externis etiam servare timendam / gentibus, haud umquam iusto mea cura labori / destitit: absciderunt tristes crudelia Parcae / stamina, nec dictis, supplex quae plurima fudi / ante Iovem frustra, lacrimisque avertere luctus / contigit; infandum natae concessit honorem, / accelerate fugam, tuque, o mea digna propago, / hac rege, virgo, patrem, gemini qua bracchia muri / litus eunt: illa, qua rere silentia, porta / stat funesta Venus ferroque accincta furentes / adiuvat — unde manus, unde haec Mavortia divae / pectora? — : tu lato patrem committe profundo, / succedam curis.
source.text_english: While fate was giving you, my son, powerful Lemnos and making it feared even by foreign peoples, my care never ceased from its rightful task: the grim Fates cut the cruel threads short, and my prayers, which I poured out in great number before Jupiter, though suppliant, and my tears, were unable to turn aside grief; they granted that unutterable honor to my daughter. Make your escape quickly, and you too, my worthy offspring, under this king, maiden, bring your father to the shore where the twin walls go down to the coast: there, at the gate where you think there is silence, stands disastrous Venus, and, girded with a sword, she aids the raging hands; whence comes this warlike heart in a goddess? Entrust your father to the wide sea; I will take over the cares.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: hinc in terras latumque profundum est iter, hinc olim soliti miscere polumque infelixque fretum neque enim tune Aeolus illis rector erat, Libya cum rumperet advena Calpen Oceanus, cum flens Siculos Oenotria fines perderet et mediis intrarent montibus undae, intonuit donec pavidis ex aethere ventis omnipotens regemque dedit, quem iussa vereri saeva cohors: vix monte chalybs iterataque muris saxa domant Euros.
reuse.text_original: hinc in terras latumque profundum / est iter, hinc olim soliti miscere polumque / infelixque fretum (neque enim tune Aeolus illis / rector erat, Libya cum rumperet advena Calpen / Oceanus, cum flens Siculos Oenotria fines / perderet et mediis intrarent montibus undae), / intonuit donec pavidis ex aethere ventis / omnipotens regemque dedit, quem iussa vereri / saeva cohors: vix monte chalybs iterataque muris / saxa domant Euros.
reuse.text_english: from here the journey is over land and deep sea, from here, once wont to mingle sky and luckless strait; for then Aeolus was not ruler over them, when the Ocean, an intruder, was breaking Calpe apart from Libya, when Oenotria, weeping, was losing the Sicilian borders, and the waves were entering among the mountain ranges, until the almighty thundered from the sky at the fearful winds and gave them a king, whom the savage band is bound to obey: scarcely do iron and the stones of the walls, doubled by the mountain, subdue the Eura.
